description: Count odd base-2 Wieferich primes up to an inclusive bounded limit.

source.title: A Search for Wieferich and Wilson Primes
source.implementation_status: bounded clean-room sieve and modular exponentiation

output.encoding: count of odd prime p<=N satisfying 2^(p-1) mod p^2 = 1

contract.definition: A Wieferich prime in this profile is an odd prime p for which p^2 divides 2^(p-1)-1; count each such p once when p is at most the inclusive input N
contract.primary_method: Sieve primes through N, then test each odd prime with binary modular exponentiation modulo p^2
contract.independent_method: Test each odd candidate for primality by trial division and compute 2^(p-1) modulo p^2 by p-1 sequential doublings
contract.overflow_proof: For N<=5000, p^2<=25,000,000 and each binary-exponentiation product is below p^4<=625,000,000,000,000, safely below INT64_MAX; the independent doubling is below 50,000,000
contract.invalid_cases: Null input, empty/non-exact frame, trailing word, or N outside [2,5000] returns -1
contract.distinction: This counts prime p satisfying a p-squared Fermat congruence. It is not a probable-prime test on one supplied number, a multiplicative-order query, or a Mersenne-primality test

complexity.primary_time: O(N log log N + pi(N) log N) sieve and modular exponentiation work
complexity.primary_space: N+1 one-byte sieve flags, at most 5,001 bytes, plus constant scalar state
complexity.independent_time: O(N sqrt(N) + N^2) trial division and linear exponent recurrence, bounded by 25,000,000 modular doublings at N<=5,000
